description: Path B workload oracle — hand-derived workload critical-path decompositions using the 17-op layer template and per-workload shape variants. All entries are hand-authored; no Path A imports or auto-generation.

frozen_policies.no_path_a_imports: Never imports sim.models, sim.engine, sim.timing.providers, sim.timing.timing_engine, sim.npu_sim or any Path A aggregator
frozen_policies.no_subsume_path_a: Does not call Path A via subprocess, sys.modules, importlib, or shared helper files
frozen_policies.template_driven: Workload critical paths derived from 17-op template + per-workload shape variants, not hand-authored 612 per-op entries
frozen_policies.cv_host_only_rubric: host_only = op that does not emit an MMIO command for MXU/SFU/Vector/DMA/NoC/KV. All host_only entries have engine=null, op=null. SFU entries include all activation-like ops (relu, hard_swish, hard_sigmoid, max_pool, avg_pool) where the trace generator computes sfu_cycles > 0.
frozen_policies.cv_varies_by_engine: Pointwise/depthwise conv → mxu/mmul. All SFU ops → sfu/silu (element-wise activation on SFU pipeline). Add/Mul in MobileNetV3 are vector ops classified as host-only due to M=K=N=0 in trace. Pool ops: when sfu_cycles>0 → sfu/silu; when sfu_cycles=0 → host-only.

softmax.decomposition: context=0→no score computation, exact zero noop

critical_path.cpath_decomposition: Serialized: sum of all 17 ops (MXU dominated by Q_proj+FFN_gate/up/down chains). QKV parallel: max(Q_proj=47104, K_proj=5824, V_proj=5824)=47104. Attention serialized with noops at 0. FFN gate+up parallel: max(122998,122998)=122998. Total serial=Q_proj+RoPE+attn_noop(0)+O_proj+resid+norm+max(FFN_gate,FFN_up)+SiLU+mul+FFN_down+resid+norm=47104+1312+0+47104+80+2400+122998+6192+430+122998+80+2400=482544. Overlap parallel reduction: QKV parallel → O_proj → FFN parallel gate+up+SiLU → gate_up_mul → FFN_down serial; overlap estimates halved for parallel chains: ≈ 241272.
critical_path.bottleneck_analysis: MXU is compute-bound for large GEMMs (Q_proj, O_proj, FFN_gate/up/down). SFU/Vector are minor contributors. Block-0 context=0 eliminates attention softmax/PV matmuls.

qwen25-3b-blk0-decode.derivation_notes: All per-op cycles derived from spec formulas using architectural constants. Decode interleaving model used for all MXU ops (M=1). Noops at context=0 for attention_QK, softmax, attention_PV.

qwen25-3b-decode-c128-g1.cpath_decomposition: Per-layer decode with context=128: attention_QK M=1,K=128,N=128→K_tiles=2,N_tiles=2≈680; softmax elements=16*128=2048→3632; attention_PV M=1,K=128,N=2048→K_tiles=2,N_tiles=32≈9008. Total per-layer serial = Q_proj(47104)+K_proj(5824)+V_proj(5824) [parallel max=47104] + RoPE(1312) + attn_QK(680) + softmax(3632) + attn_PV(9008) + O_proj(47104) + resid(80) + rmsnorm(2400) + FFN_gate(122998) [parallel with FFN_up(122998)] + SiLU(6192) + mul(430) + FFN_down(122998) + resid(80) + rmsnorm(2400) = QKV+RoPE+attn_chain+O+resid+norm+max(FFN_gate,FFN_up)+SiLU+mul+FFN_down+resid+norm = 47104+1312+680+3632+9008+47104+80+2400+122998+6192+430+122998+80+2400 = 488884. Times 36 layers = 17599824. Overlap reduction halves parallel chains.
qwen25-3b-decode-c128-g1.derivation_notes: Same 17-op pattern per layer. Attention matmuls (QK, PV) now active with context=128. Decode interleaving for all MXU. KV cache access (context=128, token_pos range) contributes additional cycles outside layer critical path.

qwen25-3b-prefill-16.cpath_decomposition: Per-layer prefill batch=16: MXU uses prefill model (M=16→M_tiles=1 partial). Q_proj M=16,K=2048,N=2048→K_tiles=32,N_tiles=32→M_tiles=1, per-tile compute=128+16=144, 1024 tiles; cold=333, 1023*144≈147312+333≈147645→ceil=148000. Similar scaling for other MXU ops. Attention: QK M=16,K=128,N=128, PV M=16,K=128,N=2048. Smooth = 16*16*128 elements=32768→256 batches * 227=58112. Total per-layer ≈ 2.93M. 36 layers ≈ 105.5M.
qwen25-3b-prefill-16.derivation_notes: Prefill batch=16 changes all MXU ops from decode interleaving to prefill model. M=16 is partial tile (M<H=64). Attention ops active. KV cache context=0 for first layer.

qwen25-3b-prefill-128.cpath_decomposition: Per-layer prefill batch=128: M=128→M_tiles=2 full. Q_proj: 2*32*32=2048 tile ops; per-tile compute=64+64+64=192 full; cold=700; bottleneck=192; 700+2047*192≈393500→ceil=408960. Attention full prefill. Softmax 128*16*128=262144 elements→2048 batches*227=464896. Total per-layer ≈ 5.95M. 36 layers ≈ 214.2M.
qwen25-3b-prefill-128.derivation_notes: Prefill batch=128 fills MXU array fully (M_tiles=2). All prefill model. Highest per-layer cost due to full M-tile utilization and large attention softmax over 128 tokens * 16 heads.

summary.host_only_breakdown: 1 shape + 10 global_avg_pool + 9 mul + 6 add + 1 concat + 1 reshape = 28 host-only entries

per_op_cycles.decomposition_notes: MobileNetV3-Small backbone + classifier head. All conv layers mapped via im2col→GEMM (map_conv_to_gemm). SFU activations: HardSwish, HardSigmoid, ReLU processed at SFU_WIDTH=128 elements/cycle. Mul/Add are element-wise vector ops classified as host-only since MobileNetV3 trace entries carry M=K=N=0 and sfu_cycles=0. Reshape/Shape/Concat/GlobalAvgPool are metadata ops with no MMIO command — host-only. Input 1x3x224x224 → GEMM MACs validated in 50M-62M range.

critical_path.cpath_decomposition: Sequential backbone: 41 pointwise + 11 depthwise convs interleaved with SFU activations. Total serial ≈ 53 GEMM ops avg 125K cycles each + 42 SFU ops avg 2.2K elements each ≈ 6.6M + 0.1M = 6.7M. Add 2 classifier GEMMs (fc1=576×1024≈9K cycles + fc2=1024×1000≈16K) + final activations ≈ 8.5M. Overlap estimate: depthwise+pointwise in stride-2 blocks have no meaningful overlap (sequential resource), ~20% reduction from host-only parallelism ≈ 6.8M.
critical_path.bottleneck_analysis: MXU dominated by large early convs (conv1: 12544*27*16 MACs, conv2: 50176*9*1 depthwise). SFU negligible. Host-only ops contribute zero MXU/SFU/Vector cycles per the manifest classification.

mobilenetv3.derivation_notes: Hand-derived from frozen mobilenetv3_perf_spec_v1.json manifest. All per-op counts exact per manifest invariants. Cycle estimates are architectural (MXU Block 64×64, SFU 128-wide). No Path A imports.

summary.gemm_breakdown: 36 pointwise_conv (1x1 bottleneck convs) + 18 gemm (3x3/7x7 convs) = 54 MXU entries

per_op_cycles.decomposition_notes: ResNet-50 Bottleneck architecture (1x1→3x3→1x1 with ReLU between). Conv1: 7x7 stride-2, then maxpool. conv2_x: 3 blocks 64→256, conv3_x: 4 blocks 128→512, conv4_x: 6 blocks 256→1024, conv5_x: 3 blocks 512→2048. Global avgpool + fc(2048→1000). All ReLU and pool ops go through SFU. Input 1x3x224x224 → GEMM MACs validated in 3.5G-4.3G range.

critical_path.cpath_decomposition: Bottleneck chains: each block has 3 convs + 3 relus (4 with downsample). conv1 (12544×147×64) ≈ 1.2M cycles. Early bottleneck: 56×56 tensors, mid: 28×28, late: 14×14 and 7×7. Total: ~53 MXU entries avg ~1M cycles + 51 SFU ops avg 2000 elements = ~54M. Overlap: max_pool/avg_pool can overlap with next conv DMA ≈ 20% reduction.
critical_path.bottleneck_analysis: Large 7×7 conv1 dominates (12544 output pixels × 147 input channels per pixel). Layer 1-3 bottlenecks (256-channel, 56×56) are second most expensive. FC layer negligible.

resnet50.derivation_notes: Hand-derived from frozen resnet50_perf_spec_v1.json manifest. All per-op counts exact per manifest invariants. All entries have engine classification (0 host-only). No Path A imports.

summary.gemm_breakdown: 63 pointwise_conv (YOLOv8n has no depthwise convs) = 63 MXU entries
summary.sfu_breakdown: 57 relu (SiLU activations mapped to SFU silu op per contract) = 57 SFU entries

per_op_cycles.decomposition_notes: YOLOv8n detection network: Backbone (Conv→C2f blocks→SPPF) + Neck (FPN-PAN with upsample/concat/C2f) + Head (P3/P4/P5 detect branches). Conv entries are all 1×1 or 3×3 pointwise mapped via map_conv_to_gemm. SiLU activations (typed as relu in trace) go through SFU. MaxPool (SPPF), Upsample (nearest-neighbor), Concat are host-only — no MMIO for MXU/SFU/Vector/DMA/NoC/KV. Input 1x3x640x640 → total MACs 2×GEMM_ops validated in 8.0G-9.5G range.

critical_path.cpath_decomposition: YOLOv8n backbone downsamples from 640→320→160→80→40→20. Neck FPN-PAN upsamples back to 80 then downsamples to 20. Detect branches at P3(80×80), P4(40×40), P5(20×20). Total 63 GEMM ops, largest at early stages (320×320×16→32 bottleneck). Avg MXU cycle per entry ≈ 1M, plus SFU activations ≈ 3M. Overlap: SPPF max_pool (3 sequential, host-only) + upsample (host-only) do not block MXU. ~20% overlap reduction.
critical_path.bottleneck_analysis: Stem convolutions (640×640) and early C2f blocks dominate. Detection head branches (1×1 projection + 3×3 conv) are relatively small. Host-only ops (upsample, concat, max_pool) contribute zero MXU/SFU cycles.

yolov8n.derivation_notes: Hand-derived from frozen yolov8n_perf_spec_v1.json manifest. All per-op counts exact per manifest invariants. 9 host-only entries are max_pool (SPPF), upsample, and concat ops. No Path A imports.

metadata.derivation_method: Hand-derived from 17-op layer template + 4 shape variants. No auto-generation from Path A.
metadata.cv_derivation_method: Hand-derived from frozen CV manifests with per-workload decomposition. No auto-generation from Path A.
